text.en:
The killing, hunting, wounding, or taking away of bubalus mindorensis, commonly known as
tamaraw, for any purpose other than for the protection of person or property, or for scientific ends duly
authorized by the Secretary of Agriculture and Commerce, is hereby prohibited.

Any person violating this Act shall be punished for each offense by imprisonment of not
exceeding thirty days or by fine of not exceeding two hundred pesos, or by both such imprisonment and fine,
in the discretion of the court.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 23, 1936.
